formulas.formula: A calm, simple budget for busy brains. One screen tells you what you can spend.
This year if the year above is blank.
Leave blank to use today's date. The example shows a day in September.
1. Type your budget year below. Leave 'Pretend today is' blank: the sheet uses today's date.
2. Plan: type your take-home pay for each month and a budget for each bucket. That's the setup!
3. Bills: list your bills once. Tick the box when you pay one. Late ones turn red.
4. Every time you spend: add a line on Quick Log (date, amount, bucket). Tick Impulse? if it was one.
5. Open Today whenever you want to know: how much can I spend right now?
6. Extras, only if you want them: No-Spend Days (streaks!), Impulse Buys and Year View.
7. Missed a few days? No guilt. Just add what you remember and keep going.
8. To start fresh: on Quick Log select columns A to E from row 2 down and press Delete,
untick the Bills boxes, and type over the example Plan and Bills.
One screen: safe to spend today and this week, buckets, bills coming up, streak.
Where you add what you spend. 5 seconds: date, amount, bucket.
Your pay, savings goal and bucket budgets. Set it once.
Bills with big tick boxes and due-date alerts.
A calendar of your no-spend days, with your current and longest streak.
What impulse buys cost you, month by month.
Every month at a glance, with charts.
Tinted cells: these fill in for you.
Red: needs attention (late bill, over budget, a typo).
Log it right away, even if it's just the amount. You can fix the details later.
Set a phone reminder for the same time every day: open Today, add what you spent.
Before an impulse buy, wait 24 hours. If you still want it, check Today first.
Put bills on autopay where you can. One less thing to remember.
Celebrate small wins: a 3-day no-spend streak is a big deal!
Thank you for your purchase! Small steps, every day. You've got this.
